title: BioCarb harmonized LCA-TEA: model, inventory, results and figures (v1.3.0)
description: Python model, life-cycle inventory, techno-economic parameters, results and figures for the article 'Biomolecule-regulated carbonation (BioCarb) as a drop-in supplementary cementitious material (SCM): harmonized life-cycle and techno-economic assessment'. Everything in the article that is a number, table or figure is produced by src/make_all.py from the CSV inputs in data/. Licensed background unit impact scores (ecoinvent 3.7 cut-off, NETL CO2U openLCA) are not included; docs/impact_factors_schema.md gives the schema and the dataset UUIDs needed to regenerate them.
